label: Бюджет 2027 — фискалните параметри, около които вървят всички спорове
text: Cash-basis deficit 3.5% of GDP (4.2% accrual) against an expected 5.6% in 2026, then 3.1% (2028) and 2.4% (2029); new borrowing capped at €8.6bn, of which €2.1bn is refinancing; debt to reach €44.3bn or 31.4% of GDP by end-2027 with a fiscal reserve floor of €2.6bn; assumptions are 2.5% real growth, 4.0% average inflation (2.6% year-end), compensation per employee +6.2% and unemployment ~3.4%. Finance Minister Galab Donev called it „фискален реализъм“ under the EU excessive-deficit procedure; Standard & Poor's moved the outlook from positive to stable, which he attributed partly to Eurostat revising the 2025 deficit from 3% to 4% of GDP and to Audit Office irregularities.
